senses.gloss: खेल (ऋ) खेऌ r. 1st cl. (खेलति) To shake to tremble, to move.

खेला f. (-ला) Play, pastime, sport
 E. खेल् to shake, अङ् and टाप् affs.

खेलन n. (-नं) Play, sport, pastime.
 f. (-नी) A piece or man at drafts,
chess, &c.
 E. खेल् to shake or move, affix ल्युट्.

खेलि f. (-लिः)
 1. A song, a hymn.
 2. An arrow.
 3. The sun.
 4. A bird.
 5.
Any animal.
 E. खेल् to shake, कि aff.
